title: ChatGPT will let you book a table mid-chat through Yelp
excerpt: ChatGPT can't join you, but it can make a reservation for you.
content_html:
ChatGPT can't join you, but it can make a reservation for you.

 

By

Shannon Connellan

Shannon Connellan

Senior Editor

Shannon Connellan is Mashable's Senior Editor, General Assignments, based in London. She has been Mashable's UK Editor (and still manages the illustrious UK team) and Australia Editor, but emotionally, she lives searching for Exit 8. A Tomatometer-approved critic, Shannon writes about entertainment, tech, social good, science, culture, and Australian horror, and loves to nerd out with movie stars, filmmakers, and TV creators.

Make a reservation mid-chat. Credit: Yelp / Mashable edit

People are using ChatGPT to sell their homes, message Tinder matches, book flights, browse their medical records, write essays, fabricate receipts, argue with their partners, shop online, talk to their cars, and order their coffee, and now they can make restaurant reservations within the app.

Announced on Monday, OpenAI's chatbot now does Yelp reservations and waitlists, meaning users in the U.S. and Canada can directly book a table while chatting with ChatGPT.

Want more tech and digital culture news delivered to your inbox daily or sent straight to your device? Sign up for Mashable's Top Stories newsletter or get Mashable push alerts today.

According to Yelp's blog post, the integration will cover restaurants using Yelp Guest Manager, the app's front-of-house reservation and waitlist system. Once guests have booked a spot through ChatGPT, any changes to the reservation must be made through the Yelp app (not the chat).

Mashable Light Speed

It's an extension of Yelp's partnership with ChatGPT, launched in July, which lets the chatbot legally use Yelp reviews, ratings, photos, and local business details to make recommendations.

ChatGPT's competitors have similar restaurant booking integrations. Google's Gemini is able to find, book, and manage reservations for restaurants on OpenTable using Reserve with Google. Microsoft Copilot can also book tables in the app using OpenTable, but, like ChatGPT's Yelp plug-in, you can't manage or cancel the reservation through the chatbot (this must be done in the OpenTable app).

Red flags and vulnerabilities can apparently take a walk when you can book a table mid-chat.

Disclosure: Ziff Davis, Mashable’s parent company, in April 2025 filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging it infringed Ziff Davis copyrights in training and operating its AI systems.

周一宣布，OpenAI 的聊天机器人现在可以进行 Yelp 预订和候补名单，这意味着美国和加拿大的用户可以在与 ChatGPT 聊天时直接预订餐桌。

根据 Yelp 的博客文章，该集成将涵盖使用 Yelp Guest Manager（该应用程序的前台预订和候补名单系统）的餐厅。 一旦客人通过 ChatGPT 预订了位置，对预订的任何更改都必须通过 Yelp 应用程序（而不是聊天）进行。

可混搭光速

这是 Yelp 与 ChatGPT 合作关系的延伸，ChatGPT 于 7 月推出，让聊天机器人可以合法地使用 Yelp 评论、评级、照片和本地商家详细信息来进行推荐。

ChatGPT 的竞争对手也有类似的餐厅预订集成。 Google 的 Gemini 能够使用 Reserve with Google 在 OpenTable 上查找、预订和管理餐厅的预订。 Microsoft Copilot 还可以使用 OpenTable 在应用程序中预订餐桌，但是，与 ChatGPT 的 Yelp 插件一样，您无法通过聊天机器人管理或取消预订（这必须在 OpenTable 应用程序中完成）。

当您可以在聊天中预订餐桌时，危险信号和漏洞显然可以消失。
